prompt: Composition: One dominant feature with smaller supporting entries, staggered hierarchy, linear mobile reading order. Build for this brief: A specialist shop; shoppers inspect objects, compare details and buy. Set headings in Libre Baskerville and reading text in Work Sans; traditional serif with flexible sans reading text. Use Spectrum 2-2: page #FBF9FA, text #2D1F25, accent #864E1D, secondary surface #E9EFE7, text on accent #FFFFFF. Use body 16px, heading 64px, line height 1.6, reading measure at most 40ch, gap 16px, content width at most 1440px and item radius 8px. Keep letter spacing zero. At 390px use a single reading order, preserve required text and provide access to every control. Use real subject imagery when needed, not ornamental blobs. Check rendered text contrast and overflow; never call this recipe proven beautiful.
